accessibility.en: The square in front is spacious and barrier-free.

photoRules.en: Photographing the facade allowed, observe safety distances.

bestTimeToVisit.de: Sonntagvormittag, wenn der Verkehr am geringsten ist.
bestTimeToVisit.hu: Vasárnap délelőtt, amikor a legkisebb a forgalom.
bestTimeToVisit.ro: Duminică dimineața, când traficul este minim.
bestTimeToVisit.en: Sunday morning, when traffic is lowest.
